notes.z: assumed solar ([M/H] = 0): HADS are Population I -> Z = 0.0169 x 10^[M/H]; X = 0.7
notes.mass: Gaia DR3 FLAME (isochrone mass from Gaia L and Teff; assumes a non-variable single star); X = 0.70 as MESA's rsp_Delta_Scuti
notes.convection: RADIATIVE MODEL: convection off (RSP_alfa = 0). With RSP's turbulent convection HADS modes are only neutrally stable; the radiative model pulsates, but its amplitude is not limited by convection (less physical than the RR Lyrae / Cepheid models)
